function openFriendLetter(name){
 const d=FRIEND_LETTERS[name],m=document.getElementById('friendLetterModal');
 if(!d||!m)return;
 document.getElementById('friendLetterFrom').textContent='A letter from '+name;
 document.getElementById('friendLetterBody').textContent=d;
 m.classList.add('open');m.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
}
function closeFriendLetter(){
 const m=document.getElementById('friendLetterModal');
 if(m){m.classList.remove('open');m.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');}
}
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeFriendLetter()});


let currentSpot = 0;
const pages = [
  document.getElementById('p1'), document.getElementById('p2'),
  document.getElementById('p3'), document.getElementById('p4'),
  document.getElementById('p5'), document.getElementById('p6'),
  document.getElementById('p7'), document.getElementById('p8'),
  document.getElementById('p9'), document.getElementById('p10')
];

function updateBook() {
  const total = pages.length;
  pages.forEach((page, idx) => {
    if (idx < currentSpot) {
      page.classList.add('flipped');
      page.style.zIndex = idx + 1;
    } else {
      page.classList.remove('flipped');
      page.style.zIndex = total - idx;
    }
  });

  document.getElementById('prevBtn').disabled = (currentSpot === 0);
  document.getElementById('nextBtn').disabled = (currentSpot === pages.length - 1);
  const sangeetPage = document.getElementById('p9');
  if (sangeetPage) {
    sangeetPage.classList.toggle('sangeet-active', currentSpot === 9);
  }

}

updateBook();







function nextPage() {
  if (currentSpot < pages.length - 1) {
    currentSpot++;
    updateBook();
  }
}

function prevPage() {
  if (currentSpot > 0) {
    currentSpot--;
    updateBook();
  }
}

function playTingSound() {
  try {
    const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
    const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
    osc.type = 'sine';
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(1200, audioCtx.currentTime); 
    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1800, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.08);
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, audioCtx.currentTime);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.4);
    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
    osc.start(audioCtx.currentTime);
    osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.42);
  } catch(e) {}
}

function showAchievementOnly(titleText) {
  const banner = document.getElementById('achieveBanner');
  const title = document.getElementById('achieveTitle');
  if (!banner || !title) return;
  title.textContent = titleText;
  banner.classList.add('show');
  setTimeout(() => banner.classList.remove('show'), 3500);
}

function triggerAchievement(titleText) {
  playTingSound();
  const banner = document.getElementById('achieveBanner');
  document.getElementById('achieveTitle').textContent = titleText;
  banner.classList.add('show');
  setTimeout(() => banner.classList.remove('show'), 3500);
}

/* PUJA PANDAL: DHAAC & FALLING FLOWERS */
function playDhaak(){
  showAchievementOnly("Festive Beginnings 🥁");
  try{
    const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;
    const ctx=new AC();
    if(ctx.state==='suspended')ctx.resume();
    const now=ctx.currentTime;

    const hit=(offset,low,volume)=>{
      const osc=ctx.createOscillator(), gain=ctx.createGain();
      osc.type='sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(low,now+offset);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(48,now+offset+.24);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,now+offset);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(volume,now+offset+.008);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,now+offset+.28);
      osc.connect(gain);gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start(now+offset);osc.stop(now+offset+.3);

      const buf=ctx.createBuffer(1,ctx.sampleRate*.12,ctx.sampleRate);
      const d=buf.getChannelData(0);
      for(let i=0;i<d.length;i++) d[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*Math.exp(-i/(ctx.sampleRate*.022));
      const n=ctx.createBufferSource(),f=ctx.createBiquadFilter(),ng=ctx.createGain();
      n.buffer=buf;f.type='lowpass';f.frequency.value=1300;
      ng.gain.setValueAtTime(volume*.32,now+offset);
      ng.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,now+offset+.12);
      n.connect(f);f.connect(ng);ng.connect(ctx.destination);
      n.start(now+offset);
    };

    [0,.15,.30,.48,.64,.82,1.02,1.20,1.40].forEach((t,i)=>hit(t,i%3===0?78:102,i%3===0?.9:.68));
    setTimeout(()=>ctx.close(),1900);
  }catch(e){}
}

}

/* CLASSROOM GAME LOGIC — starts only after clicking the game */
let catchScore = 0;
let catchGameStarted = false;
let catchTimers = [];
const trashBin = document.getElementById('trashBin');
const gameArea = document.getElementById('gameArea');

function startCatchGame() {
  if (!gameArea || catchGameStarted) return;
  catchGameStarted = true;
  catchScore = 0;
  const scoreEl=document.getElementById('catchScore');
  if(scoreEl) scoreEl.textContent='0';
  const overlay=gameArea.querySelector('.game-start-overlay');
  if(overlay) overlay.classList.add('hidden');
  catchTimers.forEach(clearInterval);
  catchTimers=[];

  gameArea.addEventListener('mousemove', moveCatchBin);
  gameArea.addEventListener('touchmove', moveCatchBin, {passive:true});

  function dropItem(id, speed) {
    const item = document.getElementById(id);
    if(!item)return;
    let top = -30;
    let left = Math.random() * Math.max(10, gameArea.clientWidth - 30);
    item.style.left = `${left}px`;

    const timer=setInterval(() => {
      top += speed;
      item.style.top = `${top}px`;
      const binLeft = parseFloat(trashBin.style.left || gameArea.clientWidth / 2);
      if (top > gameArea.clientHeight - 40 && Math.abs(left - binLeft) < 40) {
        catchScore += 10;
        const sc=document.getElementById('catchScore');
        if(sc) sc.textContent=catchScore;
        playTingSound();
        top=-30;
        left=Math.random()*Math.max(10,gameArea.clientWidth-30);
        item.style.left=`${left}px`;
        if(catchScore===50) triggerAchievement("Academic Ace Catch 📝💯");
      }
      if(top>gameArea.clientHeight){
        top=-30;
        left=Math.random()*Math.max(10,gameArea.clientWidth-30);
        item.style.left=`${left}px`;
      }
    },24);
    catchTimers.push(timer);
  }
  dropItem('fallingPencil',4.2);
  dropItem('fallingPaper',5.0);
}

function moveCatchBin(e){
  if(!catchGameStarted || !gameArea || !trashBin)return;
  const rect=gameArea.getBoundingClientRect();
  const clientX=e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX;
  const x=clientX-rect.left-20;
  trashBin.style.left=`${Math.max(10,Math.min(rect.width-30,x))}px`;
}

/* FOOTBALL SHOOTING GAME — score tally */
let footballScore = 0;
let footballShots = 0;

function shootBall() {
  const ball=document.getElementById('football');
  const keeper=document.getElementById('keeper');
  const result=document.getElementById('footballResult');
  if(!ball||!keeper)return;
  footballShots++;
  const shots=document.getElementById('footballShots');
  if(shots)shots.textContent=footballShots;

  const keeperPos=(Math.random()-0.5)*70;
  keeper.style.left=`calc(50% + ${keeperPos}px)`;
  const ballTargetX=(Math.random()-0.5)*60;
  ball.style.bottom='100px';
  ball.style.left=`calc(50% + ${ballTargetX}px)`;

  setTimeout(()=>{
    const goal=Math.abs(ballTargetX-keeperPos)>20;
    if(goal){
      footballScore++;
      const score=document.getElementById('footballScore');
      if(score)score.textContent=footballScore;
      if(result){result.textContent=`⚽ GOAL! Past the keeper! — ${footballScore} GOAL${footballScore===1?'':'S'}`;result.classList.add('goal-result');}
      triggerAchievement(`GOAL! ⚽ Past the keeper! Score: ${footballScore}`);
      if(footballScore===3) triggerAchievement("Football Finisher: 3 Goals! ⚽🏆");
    }else{
      if(result){result.textContent='❌ MISSED! The keeper got it!';result.classList.add('miss-result');}
      playTingSound();
    }
    setTimeout(()=>{
      ball.style.bottom='10px';
      ball.style.left='50%';
      keeper.style.left='50%';
    },900);
  },500);
}

function playBirthdaySong(){
  try{
    const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;
    const ctx=new AC();
    if(ctx.state==='suspended')ctx.resume();
    const now=ctx.currentTime;
    const notes=[392,392,440,392,523.25,493.88,392,392,440,392,587.33,523.25,392,392,783.99,659.25,523.25,493.88,440,698.46,698.46,659.25,523.25,587.33,523.25];
    notes.forEach((f,i)=>{
      const o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();
      const t=now+i*.27;
      o.type='triangle';o.frequency.value=f;
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.22,t+.025);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+.24);
      o.connect(g);g.connect(ctx.destination);
      o.start(t);o.stop(t+.25);
    });
    setTimeout(()=>{try{ctx.close()}catch(e){}},7200);
  }catch(e){}
}

function playBirthdayCheers(){
  try{
    const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;
    const ctx=new AC();
    if(ctx.state==='suspended')ctx.resume();
    const now=ctx.currentTime;

    [0,.35,.7,1.05].forEach((t,i)=>{
      const o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();
      o.type='sawtooth';
      o.frequency.setValueAtTime(190+i*20,now+t);
      o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(650+i*45,now+t+.3);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,now+t);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.12,now+t+.04);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,now+t+.34);
      o.connect(g);g.connect(ctx.destination);
      o.start(now+t);o.stop(now+t+.36);
    });

    const buffer=ctx.createBuffer(1,ctx.sampleRate*1.7,ctx.sampleRate);
    const data=buffer.getChannelData(0);
    for(let i=0;i<data.length;i++){
      const t=i/ctx.sampleRate;
      const clap=(Math.sin(2*Math.PI*7*t)>0.55)?1:.16;
      data[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*.22*clap*Math.exp(-t*.65);
    }
    const n=ctx.createBufferSource(),ng=ctx.createGain();
    n.buffer=buffer;ng.gain.value=.65;n.connect(ng);ng.connect(ctx.destination);n.start();
    setTimeout(()=>{try{ctx.close()}catch(e){}},1900);
  }catch(e){}
}

function launchRealConfetti(){
  const layer=document.getElementById('confettiLayerV11');
  if(!layer)return;
  layer.innerHTML='';
  const shapes=['rect','circle','strip'];
  for(let i=0;i<125;i++){
    const piece=document.createElement('span');
    piece.className='real-confetti-piece';
    piece.dataset.shape=shapes[i%3];
    piece.style.left=(Math.random()*100)+'%';
    piece.style.setProperty('--drift',((Math.random()-.5)*260)+'px');
    piece.style.setProperty('--spin',(360+Math.random()*900)+'deg');
    piece.style.setProperty('--delay',(Math.random()*.7)+'s');
    piece.style.setProperty('--duration',(2.5+Math.random()*2.5)+'s');
    piece.style.setProperty('--size',(5+Math.random()*7)+'px');
    layer.appendChild(piece);
  }
}

function blowBirthdayCandles(){
  const cake=document.getElementById('birthdayCake');
  if(!cake || cake.dataset.blown==='true')return;
  cake.dataset.blown='true';

  cake.querySelectorAll('.candle-v11 i').forEach(flame=>{
    flame.classList.add('blown');
  });

  const msg=document.getElementById('cakeMessage');
  const wish=document.getElementById('finalWish');
  if(msg)msg.textContent='🎉 WISH MADE! 🎉';
  if(wish)wish.textContent='Wish made ✦ Happy Birthday, love ❤️';

  launchRealConfetti();
  playBirthdaySong();
  playBirthdayCheers();
  triggerAchievement('Birthday Wish Made! 🎂🎉✨');
}


function playBirthdaySong(){
  try{
    const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext,ctx=new AC();
    if(ctx.state==='suspended')ctx.resume();
    const notes=[392,392,440,392,523,494,392,392,440,392,587,523,392,392,784,659,523,494,440,698,698,659,523,587,523];
    const now=ctx.currentTime;
    notes.forEach((f,i)=>{
      const o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();
      const t=now+i*.28;
      o.type='triangle';o.frequency.value=f;
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.20,t+.025);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+.25);
      o.connect(g);g.connect(ctx.destination);o.start(t);o.stop(t+.27);
    });
    setTimeout(()=>ctx.close(),7600);
  }catch(e){}
}
function playBirthdayCheers(){
  try{
    const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext,ctx=new AC();
    if(ctx.state==='suspended')ctx.resume();
    const now=ctx.currentTime;
    [0,.35,.7,1.05].forEach((t,i)=>{
      const o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();
      o.type='sawtooth';o.frequency.setValueAtTime(180+i*25,now+t);o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(650+i*40,now+t+.3);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,now+t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.13,now+t+.04);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,now+t+.34);
      o.connect(g);g.connect(ctx.destination);o.start(now+t);o.stop(now+t+.36);
    });
    // clap-like noise
    const b=ctx.createBuffer(1,ctx.sampleRate*1.5,ctx.sampleRate),d=b.getChannelData(0);
    for(let i=0;i<d.length;i++){const t=i/ctx.sampleRate;d[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*(.08+.12*(Math.sin(2*Math.PI*7*t)>0.55?1:0))*Math.exp(-t*.45);}
    const n=ctx.createBufferSource(),g=ctx.createGain();n.buffer=b;g.gain.value=1;n.connect(g);g.connect(ctx.destination);n.start();
    setTimeout(()=>ctx.close(),1800);
  }catch(e){}
}
